cohort: Pregnant women hospitalized for delivery at the university hospital in Conakry, Guinea, during 2016-2017
finding: Transfer from another hospital, misoprostol-induced labor, non-use of partogram, duration of labor ≥24 h, and positive history of cesarean section were significantly associated with increased odds of maternal death.
mod_finding: History of cesarean section was significantly associated with increased odds of maternal death.
